metaDescription: Host your own Free Fire tournaments and scrims on AFC. Start an organization in two minutes; every tool is free.

hero.title: Host your own tournaments on AFC
hero.intro: Start an organization in two minutes and run scrims and tournaments for the whole community. Every tool is free, for everyone.

signups.title: Sign-ups, groups and matches
signups.body: Teams register on your event page. You approve them and AFC builds the groups.

screenshots.title: Results from screenshots
screenshots.body: Upload the end-of-match screen. We fill in the leaderboard. You check it.

stream.title: Live leaderboards for your stream
stream.body: Overlays for OBS that update by themselves.

helpers.title: Your helpers
helpers.body: Invite people and give each one only the jobs they do.

badge.title: A badge players trust
badge.body: Run good events to earn the Verified tick, and maybe become an AFC Partner.

step1.title: Name your organization
step1.lead: This is how players will know you. You can change it later.
step1.countryHint: Helps players near you find your events.

step2.title: Tell players about you
step2.lead: A few words and a way to reach you.
step2.aboutPlaceholder: What events do you run, and for whom?
step2.agree: I will follow the organizer rules: fair rules on every event, trophies handed over as promised, and no pretending to be someone else.

done.title: {name} is ready
done.body: Your page is live at africanfreefirecommunity.com/organizations/{slug}. Every tool is yours, free.
done.screenshots: Try reading results from a screenshot

badge.communityHint: A Community organizer. Every tool works the same; its results do not count for the AFC rankings.
badge.verifiedHint: Verified by AFC: this organizer's results count for the AFC rankings.
badge.partnerHint: An AFC Partner: an organizer AFC works with directly.

emailNotice: Updates for this event come as notifications on AFC, not by email.
